# Rance9

> Rance9 is an independent software studio.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rance9.com/): Projects, About and Contact.
- [New Carts](https://rance9.com/new-carts/): Five original game concepts for the NES: Crowned, One Flame, Scribble Beast, Bolts and Drop & Dash.
- [Privacy](https://rance9.com/privacy/): Website privacy and hosting information.
